g.text: Why NEEDED is not a scheduler state
Rerun is per submission, so exactly one
container works on a submission at a time.
There is nothing to race against, so no claim
step and no IN_PROGRESS state are required.
Retry falls out of the design: a task that
fails stays NEEDED, the submission guard is
not set, and the next nightly trigger picks
the submission up and retries only the tasks
solely to stop a permanently broken target
